1. Water just sits on top instead of soaking in.
2. You dig a shovel's width and find zero earthworms.

3. A white crust forms on the surface after it dries.
4. Plants wilt by afternoon even on days you watered.

slides.texto_pie: 5. It smells like rotten eggs when you turn it over — that's the real tell.

slides.texto_cuerpo: Your soil's been trying to tell you. Soil health troubleshooting guide, link in bio.
